_comment: Admin-friendly Release & Download Configuration for Anime Universe. Update downloadUrl (must use https://), version, fileSize, releaseDate, available, githubRepo, currentRelease, or previousVersions here without modifying any frontend code.

currentRelease.title: Obsidian & Champagne Gold Parity + Instant Cloud Sync
currentRelease.summary: Unified 1:1 visual design across Android, Windows, macOS, and Web with instant startup session restore and automatic background cloud synchronization.

highlights.text: Automatic real-time cross-platform cloud synchronization every 15 seconds across Android, Windows, macOS, and Web without manual refresh.
Eliminated the 4–5 second startup login flash on Android APK and Desktop by caching verified session snapshots locally.
1:1 Obsidian & Champagne Gold visual parity across Home Weekly Schedule, Global Catalog Discover, Library Collections, and Community Reviews.
Added seamless Email or Username sign-in resolution and automatic background JWT session refresh.

previousVersions.title: Community Lounge & Sentiment Tier Filtering
notes: Added 5-tier sentiment badges (Absolute Cinema, Worth Watching, One Time Watch, Boring, Total Waste) across Library and Community.
Introduced custom user Collections with Supabase cloud persistence.
Improved AniList GraphQL seasonal and Donghua catalog filtering.
